topic.description: 减少Agent反复Read、Grep、Glob、代码探索、上下文构建和规划等待， 从而缩短端到端任务完成时间的技术，而非仅指语义缓存。

facts.title: How to judge if a meeting is efficient: An efficient meeting has no to-do list left behind, because all the actions are done DURING the meeting (either by agents who listen to the meeting in real time or by humans) The gap between saying and doing should be zero, and meetings become work sessions where things actually get DONE。
facts.event_hint: Discovery-only social opinion about real-time meeting agents executing action items
facts.problem: 该候选主张会议中的 Agent 或人应实时完成行动项，但来源 discovery_only=true，不能将观点升级为 Agent 任务效率或成功率证据。
facts.mechanism: 未提升任何机制性事实；正文只表达观点，无法确认实时监听、任务执行、工具调用或结果验收流程。
facts.evaluation_context: 来源为 B 级 Follow Builders/X 发现，抓取文本为单条社交媒体观点且 discovery_only=true。没有 Read/Grep、工具调用、token、任务成功率或端到端时延数据。
facts.limitations: 该候选尚未完成可用于专题汇总的来源解析和证据核验；不能把“说到做到”的愿景当作实际部署效果。需要产品文档、任务日志和对照测量来确认。
